videos.description:
Oil slips while Asian stocks and US futures edge higher, on signs Iran may re-enter negotiations ahead of the ceasefire deadline. Also on the show: US President Donald Trump tells Bloomberg he's unlikely to extend the temporary truce; Apple's Tim Cook set to hand the reins to hardware chief, John Ternus; Trump's pick to be the next Fed leader, Kevin Warsh, is set to testify before the Senate Banking Committee.
